description: Official MITRE CALDERA for OT BACnet abilities for validating data staging and collection behaviors before exfiltration. Provides 24 Morgana Scripts for ATT&CK for ICS Collection with verified protocol assets where required; CALDERA is not required at runtime.
author: MITRE (converted by X3M.AI for Morgana)
prerequisites: Morgana agent installed on an explicitly authorized execution host
Required OT facts supplied as Morgana tag values; no target defaults are provided
Required assets downloaded from Camelot and verified by SHA256
capabilities: Provides official MITRE CALDERA for OT BACnet behaviors for ATT&CK for ICS Collection.
Exercises data staging and collection behaviors before exfiltration against an operator-supplied BACnet simulator, lab, or approved target.
Uses verified package assets and protocol-specific parameters where required (12 unique assets in this pack).
use_cases: Validate BACnet monitoring, industrial telemetry, and ATT&CK for ICS detection coverage.
Run focused Collection exercises in an isolated OT lab or cyber range.
Assess whether defensive controls distinguish read-only protocol activity from process-changing behavior.
safety_notes: Highest operational risk in this pack: OBSERVE. Review the risk badge on every Script before execution.
No target values are supplied; configure only an explicitly authorized lab, simulation, or approved production exercise.
Verified assets are downloaded only when a Script is explicitly executed; importing the pack never contacts an OT target.

scripts.id: OT - BACNET - T0861 - BACnet Read Property Multiple [Linux/Bash]
scripts.name: OT - BACNET - T0861 - BACnet Read Property Multiple [Linux/Bash]
scripts.description:
BACnet Service:   ReadPropertyMultiple Service Category: Object Access 
The ReadPropertyMultiple service is used by a client BACnet-user to request the values of one or more specified properties of one ore more BACnet Objects. For example, a single property for a single object, a list of properties for a single object, or even any number of properties for any number of objects. 
For #{bacnet.obj.property} the value "8" can be provided to read the ALL Property if "device" is provided for #{bacnet.obj.type}.
scripts.cleanup_command: printf '%s\n' '[INFO] T0861 cleanup: upstream ability provides no cleanup command'
